high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "index.daily," which is based in New Delhi, India. The post is titled "1991, The Year of Bankruptcy." It discusses the financial crisis faced by India at the beginning of 1991. The post begins with a bold statement: "By the beginning of the year 1991, India had just $1.2 billion of foreign reserves left. The number further went down to $600 million in June 1991." It then explains that India was left with foreign exchange to fund
